skill.name: email-render-builder
skill.description: Builds responsive, table-based email HTML from approved copy and audits rendering across Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android.
skill.summary: Build responsive email HTML with dark-mode, accessibility, image-off, and client-render QA.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown links, fenced examples, fixed memory paths, and email-client terminology. One medium-risk finding is confirmed: the skill includes an optional python3 Resend connector command that can perform a live render-test send when explicitly requested.

remediation.issue: Optional live render-test send through the Resend connector
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run as the default, require explicit user confirmation before --live, and restrict recipients to user-owned test inboxes.

remediation.issue: External connector execution in skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Document required credentials, avoid logging secrets, and state that the connector must not send campaign traffic.

content.value_statement: Email HTML often breaks across clients, dark mode, and image-off settings. This skill turns approved copy into a responsive build and a QA report that separates measured results from estimates.
actual_capabilities: Converts approved copy or existing HTML into responsive table-based email markup.
Checks dark-mode contrast, image-off readability, alt text, and bulletproof CTAs.
Produces a client-render matrix for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android.
Creates or checks a plain-text alternate for message and link parity.
Labels render claims as Measured or Estimated based on available seed or preview data.
limitations: Does not write new marketing copy or change approved wording.
Does not score SEND quality or compute EQS.
Estimated render results are not a substitute for seed-list or inbox-preview testing.
Optional ESP connector use requires user-owned test inboxes and explicit live-send permission.

use_cases.title: Marketing Operations Build
use_cases.description: Turn approved campaign copy into responsive email HTML with a QA report for target clients.

use_cases.title: Developer Render QA
use_cases.description: Review existing HTML for Outlook, Gmail, dark mode, image-off, and accessibility issues before handoff.

use_cases.title: Campaign Acceptance Check
use_cases.description: Confirm that the HTML and plain-text alternate carry the same CTA, message, and destination URL.

prompt_templates.title: Build from Approved Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Build responsive email HTML from this approved copy: [copy]. Use this destination URL: [URL]. Target standard email clients.

prompt_templates.title: QA Existing HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: QA this email HTML for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android: [HTML]. Flag dark-mode, image-off, and accessibility defects.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Render Defects
prompt_templates.prompt: This email breaks in Outlook and image-off mode: [HTML]. Fix the layout, keep the copy unchanged, and explain every render change.

prompt_templates.title: Build Measured Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these seed-test results and this HTML: [results and HTML]. Build the client-render matrix, label measured rows, and list open loops.

output_examples.input: Approved sale email copy with a CTA URL and brand colors.
output: Responsive table-based email build ready for review.
Dark-mode and accessibility checklist with pass or fail notes.
Plain-text alternate matching the HTML message and CTA.

output_examples.input: Existing newsletter HTML that clips in Gmail and fails images-off review.
output_examples.output: A render-QA report identifying Gmail clipping risk, missing alt text, weak fallbacks, and required fixes.

output_examples.input: Seed inbox screenshots for Gmail, Outlook, and Apple Mail.
output_examples.output: A client-render matrix with measured rows, estimated rows, defects, and open loops.

best_practices: Provide approved copy, CTA URL, target clients, and brand constraints before building.
Use seed-list or inbox-preview results when render accuracy matters.
Keep copy changes outside this skill and route wording issues to the copy owner.
anti_patterns: Treating estimated client behavior as measured render proof.
Placing the main offer, price, or CTA only inside an image.
Running live ESP sends without explicit permission and test-only recipients.

faq.question: Does this skill write email copy?
faq.answer: No. It builds and audits HTML from approved copy or existing HTML.

faq.question: Which email clients does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android by default.

faq.question: Can it verify real inbox rendering?
faq.answer: Only when the user provides seed-list, inbox-preview, or render-preview results.

faq.question: Does it support dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks foreground and background contrast under light and dark-mode behavior.

faq.question: Can it create a plain-text email version?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create or check a plain-text alternate for message and link parity.

faq.question: Can it send test emails?
faq.answer: It documents an optional Resend test-send path, but live sends require explicit permission.
